constraints: SI-10 (canonical, fixed contract): signature is list_claims(self) -> list[TaskClaim], returning ONE TaskClaim per currently-held claim, each carrying task_id, worker_id, claimed_at, lease_expires_at, version. Do not change this name or shape -- downstream spec 00032 implements it verbatim on Postgres.

Released/deleted claims (rows removed by release_claim) must be absent from the result; the listing reports raw held-row state, so an expired-but-not-yet-stolen lease still appears (consistent with the existing load_claim contract). Do not filter on lease expiry.
Claim enumeration stays in the orchestrator layer (flywheel-orchestrator); do NOT add anything claim-related to flywheel-core -- core must not learn about workers.
SI-9: no schema change to task_claims and no orchestrator_schema_version bump; list_claims reads existing columns only.
Commit the change with a Conventional Commits message (e.g. 'feat:') before reporting done.
Run mcp__ide__getDiagnostics on every .py file you touch and fix all Pylance errors before reporting done.
non_goals: GRADING SURFACE -- do not create, edit, read, or open anything under .flywheel/holdout/00031-spend-and-worker-aggregates/. The held-out claim-enumeration test seeds (task_id, worker_id) pairs your implementation does not see.
Do not weaken, delete, or @skip any existing test under packages/*/tests/.
Do not add cross-task selection / scheduling logic (which task runs next) -- that stays above and is out of scope here.
Do not add a filter-by-worker or filter-by-status parameter to list_claims -- it takes no arguments per SI-10.
edge_cases: Two or more live claims owned by distinct workers: the enumerated set of (task_id, worker_id) pairs equals the set acquired, order-independent -- a single-claim return must fail.
Each entry carries the worker_id, not just the task_id -- a task-ids-only return must fail.
After release_claim on one of two held claims, only the still-held claim's task_id is present -- a stale snapshot that still reports the freed worker must fail.
Empty claim store returns an empty list, never None and never a raise.
